segments.en: Please grace me — and open my eyes in what we find in the writings of the Ari, of blessed memory. For in one place he says that ChaGa"T of Ze'ir Anpin rose and became ChaBa"D, and NeHi" came to him in the dimension of addition, and are therefore called "outside the body." And in another place he says that the mochin (mental lights) come to him in the dimension of addition, and during nursing he is [only] six extremities. And in yet another place he says that two thirds rose to ChaBa"D, and the NeHi" of Ima complete his vessels.

segments.en: And another question: Can we have in mind in every Blessing of the Patriarchs (Avos) — meaning the Shacharis, Mussaf, and Mincha of Shabbos and Yom Tov — the same intention as Shacharis of a weekday, concentrating only on the mochin and the added lights in Koneh HaKol ("Creator of all") — which is the culmination of the entry of the mochin into him — and similarly in the Name of the second standing? I beseech his face: let him guide me in righteousness and illuminate my darkness, for surely he alone gathers the wonders of Wisdom in its clarity.

segments.en: Concerning what he asked me regarding Ze'ir Anpin — that the mochin come to him in the dimension of addition, and also the NeHi", and his growth through them: I already reflected on this and asked my teacher the Ramaz (R. Moshe Zacuto, his teacher's teacher) about the variation in the language of R. Chaim Vital on these matters. And he replied to me: The general distinction is: what is spoken of regarding the division of the thirds of Chesed and Netzach to make Chachma, and so in the rest — and then the three sections of NeHi" of Ima coming to join them — that is for the enlargement of Ze'ir Anpin himself. And afterward, at the time of building the Nukva, whose entire building is from his NeHi" — then new NeHi" must come to him since the first ones are given to the Nukva. And this is what is written in the Likhutim: the NeHi" of Ze'ir are all made from Bina — in the secret of "and from Bina come the prophets." And with this the sources do not contradict each other, and all fits beautifully — end of his words. See also in Adam Yashar, in the drush beginning "There is supernal Da'as in Ze'ir Anpin" — at its end there is a passage beginning: "Understand in Nasso page 123b" — where there is a great matter here.

segments.he: להיותם פעולת המאציל ,ו אין כח אחד בחלק אחד מן הפועל ,יותר מבחלק אחר .כי כל הפועל פועל בכל פעולותיו .רק הצמצום הוא הגבול הראשון אשר הושם לפעולות ,ואינו העדר ,רק מציאות .כי התנוצצות הוא שרש הדין המתגלה ,ומשים גבול לפעולה להנהגתה .וכל שאר המדריגות כמו כן יורדות זו מזו בהדרגת כחות ,כח אחר כח ,בין בבריאה בין בהנהגה .והכל תלוי בכונת הבריאה ,שהיא להיות אדם בבחירה .כי כולן צריכות ,ואם יחסרו או יותירו לא היה האדם כך .ובאמת כל אלה העיקרים הם עמוקים הרבה .ואם הייתי יכול להאריך בהם הביאור — הייתי מראה לו דברים נפלאים.
segments.en: Concerning the intention of the Blessing of the Patriarchs in the Mussaf prayers, etc. — on this too I opened my eyes when I was delighting in the garden of Eden of my teacher the Ramaz. And what is written with me in my book of Kavanos in the matter of the general need for prayers: I asked my teacher the Ramaz — may his light shine — whether one should concentrate in the Avos of Mussaf Rosh Chodesh with the intention of Shacharis, and he replied to me: I will answer you — for in all my days my heart has not filled itself to concentrate that intention except in the silent Shacharis. For even in the repetition I concentrate only in a general way in the first blessing — to draw illumination from Chesed, and in Gevuros to draw it from Gevura — as written explicitly in the book of Kavanos. And excluding one who concentrates in all his prayers the intention of Shacharis, etc. And certainly in Mincha, in the union of Yisrael and Leah, one should not even come close to the Shacharis intention at all. And in Ma'ariv it is written explicitly in the book of Kavanos that there is a different intention in the Avos of Ma'ariv, but we have not merited it. In short: only in the silent Shacharis do I concentrate the kavanos transmitted to us by our master the Ari, and in the other prayers I concentrate in a general way — end of his words.

segments.en: And another time he wrote to me: However, in Mussaf of Rosh Chodesh this is my practice — to concentrate in general on the place of the ascent of Yaakov and the Nukva in the silent prayer and the repetition, and on the place of their receiving light from behind Keter of Yissuos. And afterward in his face. And similarly I concentrate on the intention of the Name Rosh Chodesh, and on the dimension of that month — whether it is from the six attributes of Ze'ir or from those of the Nukva — and with the combination of that הוי"ה and אהי"ה that rules in that month, as it is known in the books. And in detail — the three heads for ChaBa"D of Ze'ir, and in the four final blessings for ChaBa"D of Yaakov and Rachel. And I also concentrate in every prayer — whether weekday or Rosh Chodesh or Shabbos and Yom Tov — in the final blessing on the union of יהו"ה and אלקים interlaced, as the Ari warned us. And know that this is the straight path a person should choose for himself — and from it he should not deviate — end of his words.

segments.he: שאו מר: ״שכחות פרטים מן העליון יפעלו יותר בהוצאת
segments.en: Apart from this I found at the beginning of the Kavana of Rosh Hashana the following: R. Yitzchak Tzemach saw in the prayerbook of R. Chaim Vital that the kavanos were marked there in brief — and were identical for all prayers whether Maariv, Shacharis, or Mincha. And this is clear proof that all the prayers' kavanos are identical — end of this passage. Perhaps this applies only on Rosh Hashana, when all the kavanos are in Gevura, as mentioned there — and therefore there is no difference. Which is not so on other days. Let these words be as frontlets between the eyes of the enlightened, and let them illuminate in them. And yet more vigilance is required — as the Zohar says in many places: lo shama'na ve-lo ima — "we have not heard and cannot say" — until the Teacher of Righteousness comes, may it be speedily.

segments.he: התחתון״ כו׳ .והוא ביאור גדול להבין הדבר לאמתו ,לבלתי יהיו סותרים זה אתזה רבים מדברי הרב הקדוש האר״י זלה״ה .כי במקום אחדי אמר שמו חי או״א מחג״ת דא״א פ״א ,וחג״ת פ״ב ,ונה״י פ״ג .ובמקום אחר* אומר שמו חי או״א הםמן הידים ,זה מן הימין וזה מן השמאל כר .ובמקום אחר 7שמוחי או״א מג״פ של הזרועות ,ו שאר הגוף מת״ת .ואמתת הענין שכל ההארות האלה הם צריכות דוקא להעמיד או״א בתכונתן .לא פחות ולא יותר .כי כלזה אינו אלא הרכבת המאורות זה בזה ,להעמיד הפעולה בגבולה .כי כלזה הוא ענין המ״ק ,שבירתן ותקונן ,להתחבר המאורות זה בזה בדרכים שונים. ואפילו בתיקון הוא כך בהתלבשות עתיק בא״א .ועניני ההתלבשות הם ענינים )1
segments.en: The first clarification is the matter of the Tzimtzum — which I have already disclosed to my honored teacher — about which others have erred, and which is well explained in the formulation: "For the Emanator does not act in His created beings with all His power simultaneously." And indeed it is impossible to speak of occupied space in the Sefiros — since they are the action of the Emanator, and there is no power in one part of the Maker greater than another part. For the entire Maker acts with all His actions. Rather, the Tzimtzum is the first boundary that was set for the actions — and it is not an absence, but an existence. For the scintillation is the root of Din (Judgment) that reveals itself, and it places a boundary on action for its governance. And all the other levels likewise descend one from another in a gradation of powers — power after power — whether in creation or in governance. And everything depends on the intention of creation — which is that there be a human being with free choice. For all are needed, and if they were lacking or excessive — the human being would not be as he is. And in truth all these principles are very deep. And if I were able to elaborate on their clarification — I would show him wondrous things.

segments.he: שםכללג. )4
segments.en: Yet another of the things that stand highest in name is the matter of the "Extension of the Sefiros" — to know the matter of the Point (nekuda), the Face (partzuf), and the 613 Lights — which are the roots of all things. For since we have form and space — it is very difficult to understand these matters. And the matter of governance is well explained — to know the connection of the levels, how they connect one to another. And all goes to one place, and it is a very, very deep matter. If I were able to send him now an Idra that I composed last Shabbos — he would find great satisfaction in it, for in it were explained all the divisions of levels, even the thirteen tikkunei dikna (configurations of the beard). What the action of each tikkun is — and other very great matters. And a great matter will be found in the "Extension of the Sefiros" — where it says: "partial powers from the upper one will act more in bringing out the lower one" etc. And it is a great explanation for understanding the matter truly — so that the many [apparently contradictory] passages of the holy Ari should not contradict each other. For in one place he says the mochin of Abba and Ima are from ChaGa"T of Arich Anpin — first face, second face, third face. In another place he says the mochin of Abba and Ima are from the arms — this from the right and this from the left. And in another place — the mochin of Abba and Ima from the three-faces of the arms, and the rest of the body from Tiferes. And the truth of the matter: all these illuminations are precisely needed to establish Abba and Ima in their configuration — not less and not more. For all of this is only the composition of the lights with one another — to establish the action within its boundary. For all this is the matter of the Primordial Kings — their breaking and their rectification — the joining of lights with one another in various ways.

segments.he: היאהאדראשבתי קון סטבספרתי קוני םחדשים. )5
segments.en: And since I am speaking of these things — let me tell him a great secret that is not in the Klalim (Principles). But it is a great premise for settling the many difficulties that arise in the kavanos. One must know: the governance depends upon the secret of the six thousand years — for these are 6,000 lights already created to govern the world, each in its time, until they are complete. And each light is a year — and requires extension in three festivals, twelve months, whose secret is the twelve combinations of הוי"ה, and the illumination of Ima in ChaGa"T. And every year one of these lights is revealed in Malchus to govern. And thus there is a union above in Zu"N for the needs of the Sefiros — which is one union. And there is another union for the needs of the year — and in it stand the rectifications of the year. Therefore, if contradictions are found many times in the kavanos — it is because one is in the universal union and one is in the annual union. And in the nesira this thing is also found throughout the Ten Days of Repentance — for there are particular mochin according to the days, and mochin according to the totality of the year. And this is a great, great secret.

segments.he: ע־חש ט־ו פ ־ו( ח־ב עכל׳ נ »ו). )6
segments.en: And let me tell him yet another secret — regarding the renewal of the world — which is a wondrous thing: to know how in the future world there shall be found no defect whatsoever in any level — yet a sinner shall not profit, for there will be a distinction between the wicked and the righteous. One might therefore ask: there will be roots that do not pour out all that belongs to them — and this is difficult. But the truth is: the eternity of the mitzvos works thus — in the first state the roots were created, and according to them the branches. But in the future world — the original structure will change, and the levels will come according to the branches: the great for the great, and the small for the small.

segments.he: ביאור הג־ שמועות ע־י פ חו־ דפרקנ. )7
segments.en: The verse says: "And it came to pass in Yeshurun — a king" [Deuteronomy 33:5]. One must know: how is it that the sole intention of Creation was to bring forth the human being who would have free will — as stated in the Klalim. And therefore all of Creation followed in what was needed for this matter. And it emerges that the beginning of Creation was the Tzimtzum of the Ein Sof, Blessed is He, and the extension of the Kav (Line). The Tzimtzum is the root of the receivers — and the Kav is the dimension of the giver that extends to act. And this very matter is the matter of Chesed and Din. And the Sages said the world was created with Din — for it is the essential, being the root of the receivers. And the Chesed is only a partnership — for He partnered with it the Attribute of Mercy — for it is the matter of bounded influence. And this very thing is the matter of inner and outer dimension. And in the descent of levels — which is the descent of the light in its power — every lower being emerges from the outer dimension of the upper one — until at the end of levels the complete outer dimension emerged — which is the physical. And it emerges from this that the secret of inner and outer, right and left, male and female — is all one matter. For when the inner and outer dimensions join and are encompassed one within the other — they joined in various ways and made all these things. And the root of all — giver and receiver — for this is the entire intention.

segments.he: ע׳ חשערהכלליםפרק ב׳.
segments.en: And behold — one will understand through this a matter that is very difficult in the words of the Ari. For he says that NHY of Atik are the mochin for Arich Anpin, and likewise NHY of Keter are the mochin for Chachma and Bina — as written in the matter of the Shevirah (Breaking). But this is not so according to the simple meaning of the clothing. Yet the depth of the matter is the secret of the composition of the lights — which compose themselves in various ways. And in truth this is a great principle in the Wisdom — and many did not know it — and therefore many matters were hidden from them. For the secret of the mochin is the inner dimension of the branch — whose root becomes a soul within it. And in truth: the root of Arich Anpin is from NHY of Atik — which is his outer dimension — and the root of Abba and Ima from NHY of Arich Anpin. But the clothing is through a different path — for it is a different composition — known in the secret of governance. I am unable to explain much now — for the matter would become very lengthy. And the words of the Ari are exceedingly obscure.

segments.he: גדולים ל מבין אותם על בורים .כי קושיות רבות נופלות בהם .והכל נמצא מתוח ב״ה במלות אשר כתבתי בכלל ההוא .ועל פי הדברים האלה ידקדק כ״ת בכל הדברים .וימצא דברים נפלאים להרחיק מן החכמה הזרות אשר נפל בה בימים הקדמונים ,ולפר ש הדברים בביאור רחב ,מקרב הדברים לפי אמתן אל השכל כדבר ה׳.
segments.en: And behold — Arich Anpin and Ze'ir Anpin are the secret of the two governances — Chesed and Din. And Nukva is the vessel of all of them — in the secret of the Agreement. And the three heads of Atik are the root of all — in the secret of ChaDa"R. For the "unknowing head" (reisha de-lo ityada) is the root of Malchus. And this is the rectification of all things — for her to have two dimensions joined: the face of the receiver toward the giver, and the face of the giver toward the receiver. And this is the secret of the union (zivug) — which is specifically the agreement of right and left. And first there is the union of kisses — which is twofold — for it is specifically the joining of right and left in the dimension of the inner. And then the influence emerges in agreement in the dimension of giver-to-receiver. And this is the union of the foundations — which is not twofold. And all these things are chapter-headings — all of them need to elaborate the verse I began, and I am condensing and concluding lest I go on too long.

segments.en: And behold — all the matters in the root need to be revealed below in the branches — which are Israel — for for their sake was the creation. And the Shechina Herself is the root of Israel. And She has two dimensions — which are themselves the secret of inner and outer — which are Leah and Rachel. And the secret: heh-heh — for Bilhah and Zilpah are only the "backs" of Rachel and Leah. And from there emerge the tribes — whose secret is vav-vav — the twelve combinations — six to the right and six to the left.

segments.en: And the secret of this matter is the matter of the two Messiahs — for they are the completion of the rectification — a very great secret. For all of Israel are the branches of the Shechina — but the King is the revelation of the root itself. And since the root is thus in its matters — the Messiahs too must be thus. And the rectification — as the secret of "and bring them one to another" — for this rectification stood to be accomplished many times — and did not succeed except at the end of the matter in the days of the Messiah. And thus the King is the revelation of the root itself — and therefore he encompasses all the branches. And this is: "and it came to pass in Yeshurun — a king when the heads of the people gathered" — for he gathers them.

segments.en: The matter: for Yosef — the Kingship rightfully belongs to him from the side of Rachel, and Yehuda from the side of Leah. And the truth is — the rectification is the joining of these two dimensions. And now let me explain who joins them: for Binyamin is the right one who joins them — for Yosef is from Yesod and Yehuda from Malchus — but Binyamin is the secret of rucha de-shavak beih ba'alah ("the spirit the husband left within her") — and he is the link between the male and the female. And therefore the primary rectifications are the Zohar — and I will explain this more particularly. For the Zohar is specifically the dimension of the drop issuing from Yesod. And therefore it is called "the brightness of the firmament" (zohar ha-rakia). And it is already known that all governance is through the union — and it is all encompassed in the influence of the drop. And when there is merit — that this drop's dimension shall reach all the way down to the lower world — all things shall be rectified through it with great rectification — for through it everything is done on all sides. And R. Shimon bar Yochai merited to be the intermediate vessel to draw this rectification — and he made the Zohar.

segments.en: Meanwhile the Ra'aya Mehemna came. He opened and said: Rabbi, Rabbi — praiseworthy is your portion, for you have aroused the supernal love as is befitting. He opened and said: May this prayer be acceptable before You — G-d of gods — highest above all — to arouse love in all the holy levels. And all the heavens of the Ofan-angels shall be bound in desire, these in those, to cleave upward. And the Sitra Achra shall be separated from them — by the power of Your holy Name יאקדונק"י — proclaim to that impure side to be removed from the world. And may all be completed in the secret of the angel Sandalfon. And all shall draw near to the faithful servant Metatron, master of the battalions. And the branches of the Tree shall be bound, these in these, by the power of the twelve holy combinations of the הוי"ה. And the Sitra Achra shall be separated from them — to be rectified in the secret of a new spirit — and to ascend above toward that supernal Kesser Yah Tzvaos — who encompasses the throne of His might. And His holy sanctuaries shall be bound in unified desire, these in these, by the power of the one Name that shines within them — which is יקו"ק vowelized with the vowels of אלקים — issuing from Bina — to strengthen in His mighty deeds — to subdue all the impure. And all shall ascend to be bound above — to that supernal rose — so that these five mighty deeds of His shall stand firmly beneath her, to guard her. And she shall ascend to join the holy King — and from there shall awaken what shall awaken — in supernal love within that hidden thought — to illuminate through the channel of the holy letters יק. And the love shall be drawn downward — for the limbs to cleave together — to fulfill the verse: "I love those who love me" [Proverbs 8:17]. For since the desire of love is bound from below to above — it will return and cleave from above to below — level by level — until it reaches the one who caused this below — and it will be said of him: "the seed of Avraham my lover" [Isaiah 41:8] — that he is bound to him to illuminate from the right — "the seed of Avraham my lover" truly. And toward both sides this "my lover" ascends — to Avraham, and to this seed — to be the beloved of the King and precious to Him. Praiseworthy is his portion.

segments.en: May it be Your will to arouse love toward Your Shechina — to redeem Her with the right hand — to rescue Mashiach ben Yosef from death — that all be bound with the right hand — and that the trees be equal — all encompassed right and left — and be unified in your hand — to be in the secret of One. Love truly — the binding of right and left — Yam: thus and thus — fifty words of unity to join the levels. "And they shall be one in your hand" [Ezekiel 37:17] — all in the secret of One — "Hashem shall be One and His Name shall be One". Blessed is He forever and ever.

segments.en: Meanwhile Metatron the great Prince came. He opened and said: Rabbi, Rabbi — truly the love has been aroused as is befitting. He opened and said: Supernal King — sweet One of all lights — the joy of all — behold Your servant waits for Your right hand — do not withhold from them — behold, the stone awaits light — for when You shall cleave to Your beloved with an inseparable cleaving — holy King — how long shall Your beloved suffer in the flames of exile? And Your holy nation that You have chosen for Yourself — they who cleave to You and are not separated — and bear for Your sake so many types of death and decrees and forced conversions — how long shall they be given into the hand of servants who rebel against You? Arouse, arouse — holy King — for the sake of the three pillars of the world. And if You will not do it for their sake — do it for the sake of the love of Your Shechina — whom You love as Your own soul — and do not abandon Her. G-d of the mighty — G-d of Avraham — G-d of Yitzchak — G-d of Yaakov — arise in Your might and redeem them. Master of all worlds — raise the Shechina! Raise the Shechina! Build Her a building for eternity — crown Her with shining crowns such as She has not been crowned since the day the worlds were created — bind Her to Yourself with an inseparable bond — and let it be known in all worlds that You alone exist and there is none beside You. Blessed is Your Name forever and ever.

segments.en: Concerning what he asked about the words of reproof with which Hashem has reproved my honored teacher in His love — let me first say that the question about this reproving: whether it is in the category of sufferings of love or sufferings of atonement — is not a simple matter at all. For the difference between them: sufferings of atonement are given to one according to the sins he has committed, and they come to atone for the damage he has caused. But sufferings of love — even if a person has no sin — they come to him. And all of this depends upon the root of the soul. For there are souls that are given sufferings of love for their own elevation — and there are souls given sufferings of love in order to atone for and elevate the generation. And there are souls given sufferings that come from Gevuros (stern judgments) — whether for atonement or from the darkness of the Sitra Achra which rules over them at certain times.

segments.en: And know that all suffering requires great examination — for just as the physician who sees symptoms of illness will not immediately say this is a certain disease — for he must examine the patient from all sides and understand what the root of the illness is — so too with suffering. One who knows the matter of souls will understand from what root each suffering comes — and will know how to respond to it. But this is not always for human beings to know in detail.

segments.en: And the general rule: every righteous person who does one particular mitzva at his level — his rectification shall come upon the entire chain of souls connected to him. For the soul is a great matter — and its root is above. And through the mitzva it raises itself with its root — and from there illumination descends to all the branches that are connected to it. And therefore every tzaddik is responsible for his generation — not merely through his actions — but through the inner dimension of his soul's action which encompasses the many.

"The first Tikkun — three alefs stand there" [Zohar, Tikkunim] And these are the secrets of the first tikkun of the Dikna (beard configuration of Arich Anpin): for the Zohar in the Tikkunim speaks of three alefs (Arichos Anpin, Abba, and Ima) and how they stand in the first tikkun. And understand the secret: the three alefs are the secret of the three roots of governance — Chesed, Din, and Rachamim — that stand in this first configuration. And the essence of the matter: there is one root of the giver — and opposite it — the reisha de-lo ityada ("head that is not known") — which is the root of Malchus. And in all three heads of Atik there are three הוי"הs and one that encompasses them all. And this matter extends through all levels — and in every head there are three that correspond to them. And this is the matter of the giver — and afterward there is the root of the receiver — and the reisha de-lo ityada — known to be the "head of nothingness" (reisha de-Ayin). And opposite these there are in each head three הוי"הs and one that encompasses. ט The Blessing of the High Priest — The Secret of "Bless Me" In the tractate of Berachos it is taught: "From where do we know that the Holy One Blessed is He prays? For R. Yishmael the Kohen Gadol said: I entered the innermost sanctuary to burn incense, and I saw the crown of the Throne (Achariel), and He said to me: Yishmael My son — bless Me." And the secret: for the blessing of the common person (birchas hedyot) — why is it not fitting to say a blessing as a common person? Rather — one who has in his mind and heart to reach the level of Arich Anpin — such as R. Yishmael did — he chose not to bless with a lower blessing standing only in Nukva. But he reached all the way to Arich Anpin — and therefore said: "May it be Your will that Your mercy overcome Your anger" etc. — which is specifically the secret of the rectification of the Giver as stated above. And regarding this blessing order he nodded his head to him. And from this we derive: "do not treat lightly the blessing of a common person" — for in the constant order of blessing we are not common persons — for we are obligated in it. Only regarding this order is one called "common" — for it is higher than all our powers. And even regarding this — he nodded his head. The Soul-Root of the Addressee — from R. Akiva — and His Rectification And regarding what my honored teacher desires that I write to him about his personal matters — let me say briefly: for I have already made known to my honored teacher how his root is from R. Akiva ben Yosef — and he underwent gilgul (transmigration) on account of the transgression of carrying from one domain to another on Shabbos — and through his efforts he rectified in his [time] the rectification of the Eruv here in the city of Padova. And this is true. For regarding the root of R. Akiva it was said "thus it arose in thought" — for in his being in the dimension of Gevuros — the Sitra Achra darkens him greatly. And there are still great secrets in this. And face to face he will hear ancient things — please G-d. And the secret of the rectification is in the matter of: "upon every thorn and point — mountains upon mountains of laws" — for his matter is from the secret of the hairs of Ze'ir Anpin. And the primary rectification is to engage in written legal rulings through pilpul (analytical debate) — and therefore it would be good for him to compose specifically works in law with much pilpul. And I will speak more with him about all these matters — please G-d. Regarding what he asked about the letters found in Adam Kadmon — truly this is a great and very deep secret. And I will explain now as I am able. The Kav that enters into the void — as the Ari said — penetrates from one side. And this is a deep matter to understand in its true meaning. And my honored teacher will see: for in one place he says the letters are in Malchus — in another place in Za"T — and in another place in all the Partzufim. But the truth of the matter: for all the worlds are entirely created in the secret of Malchus — and this is the secret of "an eshet chayil is the crown of her husband" — she ascends until the Ein Sof and descends to no final limit. And this is the one side through which the Kav pierced — and it is the governance that proceeds in this way. And Nature stands by these laws. And if it had been from another side — it would have been in another way — and Nature in another way. And now everything stands always in the secret of Malchus — and this is the matter that all the Partzufim are letters — only there are letters that are cantillation-marks, letters that are vowels, and letters that are crowns, and letters as they are — as the Ari says in one place. Yet even with all this — the dimension of the letters is only known in its place — which is below — for its place is in Malchus. Yet in Ze'ir Anpin itself they are revealed too — and there it is called shaglemu osvan ("the letters were completed") — not so above — for even in Bina they are not revealed, for they are only emerging — meaning: emerging in the dimension of their raw material. But above in Adam Kadmon all is in the dimension of root — for the secret of Adam Kadmon is only the general root. And it emerges that all the Ta"NTa therein are only in the dimension of the cantillation-marks of the totality of the worlds. Part Three — Letters Yod-Alef through Yod-Tes יא The Gilgulim and the Foundation of Mashiach ben Yosef Padova, night of Shabbos Kodesh, 9th Adar 5490 It is written: "Fortunate is the man whom You, G-d, afflict — and from Your Torah You teach him" [Psalms 94:12]. For this verse is said about Mashiach ben Yosef. And in truth — in the book of the Zohar, R. Shimon bar Yochai says that Mashiach ben Yosef undergoes gilgulim many times in order to be saved from Armilos. And this is a wondrous matter — for it was already said that in every generation there are the two Messiahs. If so — what is different about Mashiach ben Yosef from Mashiach ben David in this? And further: when we understand the matter of the two Messiahs — it becomes even harder. For one cannot say that there is only one soul that undergoes transmigration many times. For it transmigrates for the needs of the generations. And if so — in each time it is rectified — and in the end all the bodies preceding the final one are found to be lost? But the truth: the two Messiahs are souls prepared to be the Messiah — and they must come from one particular root prepared for this — but they can be various sparks — all from that particular root. And the last will redeem Israel. But now it becomes even harder regarding gilgul — for what suffering is there that can save from Armilos? Are they not separate souls — and not even gilgul can be called this? But the truth of the matter is: everything we speak of regarding the Messiah is all about the Yechida (the highest level of the soul) — which is the Messiah specifically — through which he can redeem. But it divides into two parts — a part for Mashiach ben David and a part for Mashiach ben Yosef. And the part that reaches Mashiach ben David sits constantly at the gates of Rome — and this is made to subdue that klippa and to extract from there the sparks of holiness. But Mashiach ben Yosef — the part that reaches him — is clothed in all those souls worthy of being Mashiach ben Yosef with complete clothing — only it cannot operate at all, and it lacks power. And in this it suffers all those deaths. Not so Mashiach ben David. And the primary suffering is the deficiency of power — for in that person all the levels are found — but in great concealment — and all power is lacking from him. And regarding this many things are said in the book of the Zohar about the Messiah standing among the erev rav, and that he has no power to act, and that Torah is not revealed to him. All of it is said about this dimension of the Yechida in Mashiach ben Yosef — standing in great sealing. But Mashiach ben David also suffers illnesses — but in a different way — for he is not in this world, but above. And Mashiach ben Yosef — he should have received the light of Torah in great abundance — but when he is in sealing — only a little light comes to him. And thus it says of him "and from Your Torah You teach him" — and not "and in Your Torah" — for only a part of all that belongs to him is given to him. And let my honored teacher know that because of this matter — many of the pursuers of the deer (i.e. followers of Shabbtai Tzvi) erred — not knowing this secret said about this soul. And since this secret is great and wondrous — I chose to present it to him as my honored teacher commanded me. יב The Ascent of the Worlds, Their Encompassing, and the Descent of Influence — The Two Great Prayers Padova, night of Shabbos Kodesh, 22nd Adar 5490 I have chosen to send him the two awe-inspiring prayers — one from the Ra'aya Mehemna, and one from Metatron the great Prince — so that he may see all in holiness and there is nothing from the Sitra Achra there. [The full text of these prayers was given above in Letter Vav — they are presented here in their original sequence as addressed to this recipient.] יג A Sin That Requires Rectification of Thought in Addition to Rectification of Deed Padova, night of Shabbos Kodesh, 8th Nissan 5490 R. Shimon bar Yochai said to Eliyahu: "There is one to whom you are destined to be revealed at the end of days — face to face. And there is one to whom you are destined to be revealed in concealment, hidden from his intellect." And one must explain why there will be these two levels — for nothing is by chance — and in everything a secret of truth and faithfulness will surely be found. And know — my honored teacher — that one difficulty is found here. And it is formidable: since we know that everything the Holy One does for Israel is only for their benefit — how can we conceive that it would be good for Israel for the nations of the world to prevent them from studying Torah — as in places where the inquisition has banned the Talmud? — Such a thing is not a rectification — but an abandonment of rectification. Yet one must know: for it is written "in order to take the house of Israel by their heart" [Ezekiel 14:5]. And this refers to the sin of impure thought through which Israel sinned — and it requires a particular rectification beyond the deed. For the Holy One links it to the deed. And therefore there must be two types of judgment: one for the rectification of the deed, and one for the rectification of the thought. And in truth for the rectification of this inner dimension it is written for the future: "and the chiefs of Yehuda shall say in their hearts: may the inhabitants of Jerusalem be my strength" — for they will be unable to pray aloud — only in their hearts shall they cry out to G-d. Two Paths of Rectification: Breaking the Sin from Without — Tearing it from Within And I will now explain the entire matter clearly. Behold — the Holy One surely measures measure for measure — through which a rectification parallel to every corruption will be found. And when souls are in exile under the klippos — two paths will be found for them to rectify the general root: either they will prevail in their choosing — strengthening in the light that reaches them — and breaking the klippos and illuminating to many. Or — from beneath the klippos themselves — like a person who stands within the belly of a lion and tears it from within — so they are in the rectifications that they increase inwardly — multiplying light and rectification — until the time when it will be said: "then your light shall break forth like the dawn" [Isaiah 58:8] — for it will literally burst open and emerge. And this is truly a great secret and a fundamental premise for those who know the ways of Hashem. Behold — according to this second path — it is the rectification that Moshe and his companions — the bearers of illness on behalf of Israel — accomplish. Of whom the Zohar says: the light does not reach them and the Torah is not revealed. And it appears that this is not a rectification — for one would expect that through the sufferings they would strengthen in the light of holiness. But the truth is that all these need to rectify according to the second path mentioned. And let my honored teacher know: as the ways of Hashem are straight and the righteous walk in them while the wicked stumble — so in truth this was a place of hiding for the perverse-hearted — the pursuers of the deer and their companions. For taking the matter according to the perversity of their evil hearts — they said to permit every gathering. But they do not know evil. For it was said here — G-d forbid — to breach any fence — not even a minor point of the words of Torah. And let my honored teacher know my secrets — for I am not revealing to others things that are the hidden matters of the world. יד A. The Killing of the Egyptian with a Name / B. The Transmission of Torah Secrets to the External Forces Padova, Tuesday 13th Nissan 5490 Concerning the apparent contradiction in the words of the Ari — I will answer briefly: the matter of the punishment that the Sages would administer by "giving his eye upon him" — is through the Name whose secret is in the eyes — in the dimension of "his eye did not dim". And it is the matter of intensifying the Judgments with great force, in the dimension of this type of sight. And the matter is lengthy. But let me speak its beginning — for time does not permit. Suffice it to say: it is a Name of Gevura that by its nature operates in this matter. And my honored teacher will see — that they did not say Moshe killed him with his eyes as in "he gave his eye upon him." Rather — with the sword in his mouth. And the matter: for two things were needed there — one: the intensification of Judgment upon the Egyptian — and one: a particular matter for that particular Egyptian, as is known — and for his rectification there was needed the Name of 42 — for the elevation of the sparks from him — but in the dimension of Gevura, for it was in Gevura that the action was drawn. And through those particular points. For thus was it transmitted above in the Written Torah at this verse — the action. The Emanations Are Illuminations in a Known and Graspable Way — and Are the Beginning of Existents And let me first explain the matter of "holiness" (Kodesh). And the rule is: Kodesh — in the mochin. But one must understand the matter well — for it is a great foundation for the constructions of Wisdom. The Emanator — may He be blessed — is distant from the level of His creatures with a distance that has no measure whatsoever. And in His all-encompassing capability He could already have brought into existence all existents in a way we would not know what it is — and the opposites He could bring into existence by one way — for there is no law or limit to His capability. And if it were so — we would not speak of His creation or His governance even one word. And the Sefiros would not exist — for His existence is the one who brings into existence — and nothing else. And since He did not wish this — but to act in a way that He makes known to us — a way close to our existence — then the Sefiros were brought into existence. They are His illuminations in a known and graspable way. As He — in the simplicity of His existence — is not as a prior cause for the consequence that follows. For there is no comparison between His existence and the existent from Him whatsoever. Therefore we do not call Him "beginning." So too these illuminations of His — they are truly the beginning of existents — for from Chesed the waters are necessitated — and from Gevura — the fire. And Chesed does not produce fire — nor Gevura — water. And thus different beginnings are found for opposites — each of which He alone could have produced. The Levels of Holiness Are Measured by Distance from the Lower Beings And since existence began to proceed in this way — proceeding toward us — to bring into existence the lower beings in progression — we can evaluate the levels: we say this level produces in progression one coarse and thick outcome — and a level above it — if it produces that outcome — will not produce it as coarse — but thinner. And this is the difference between the roots of the spiritual beings and the physical — and between their own roots one with another. When we begin to understand the levels from below upward — we find the lower one is closer to us — for it produces us. And the higher we ascend — the more distant they are found from this proximity. And then we distinguish the holy (kadashim) from the holiest (kodshei kodashim) — for the more proximate ones are called "holy" — and those that are more distant from it are called "holiest of holies." And let my honored teacher see — all existence is "kodesh." For the difference is enormous between the Sefiros themselves — which are the essentiality of the Emanator — and their offspring which are created beings and not Divinity. And therefore the created waters — in being created — are immediately profane. But Chesed is holy — for it is only the illumination of the Emanator who wishes to bring out through that path only water and nothing else. Ze'ir Anpin — When It Receives the Mochin — Is Called "Holy" Let us return to the matter: all existence is "kodesh." And according to its distance from the closeness it has with the lower beings — its level of holiness is elevated. And this is why they called Atik Yomin in the Idra "holiest of holies of the holies" — for kudshaya are Ze'ir and Nukva — and the kudshei kudshaya are Abba and Ima — and the kodesh kodashim de-kudshaya is Arich Anpin — for thus the levels are elevated one from another. And it emerges that Ze'ir and Nukva are closest to us — of whom it says "the revealed things belong to us and to our children" — for they are accounted as the seven lower (Za"T) — for they produce the matters of the world in progression. And the mochin — Abba and Ima in Atzilus or ChaBa"D in Ze'ir — are distant from this closeness — therefore they are called "kodesh." And Ze'ir — when it receives the mochin — is called "Kadosh" — meaning: the Kodesh is in him. The Meaning of "HaKadosh Baruch Hu" And now we have understood the matter of "kodesh" and "kadosh." But this matter ascends very, very far above — and it is a great and sublime secret that was not permitted to be revealed so much — but for the honor of my honored teacher whose honor it is my obligation to clarify now what I can in this matter. For the thread of the Ein Sof — may He be blessed — is the Operator of all the operations encompassed in the ten Sefiros. And when the Emanator placed a boundary on His light — He left the reshimu (impression) — which is what remains from this boundary. For the boundary did not remove all His illumination — but only diminished it. And what remains in this diminishment is the reshimu. And this is the dimension of Malchus. For when the Sefiros are found — and we evaluate all things by the accounting of these ten Sefiros — the reshimu is found in the value of Malchus. And the thread that enters within the reshimu — is an illumination greater and a stronger light — which the first boundary did not leave — and which later increased upon it by the will of the Emanator. And the thread and the reshimu are found in the value of the vav-heh of the Name — which is Za"T. And the Ein Sof is elevated above this — meaning: completely distant from the production of any lower existent in sequence — even as a cause of causes. And yet He did not distance Himself completely — for He faces this production — and without His facing and His cleaving — no illumination would have existence — for His illuminations are all the lights. The thread — which is the totality of all the Sefiros — is in the dimension of Ze'ir Anpin. And it is "holy" (kadosh) — for the cleaving of the Ein Sof sanctified it. And we speak of what is closer to us — not of what is completely distant from us — and to this thread is truly called "HaKadosh Baruch Hu" (K"BH). And when we speak in particulars — even though all the Sefiros and Partzufim are only parts of the thread — nevertheless Arich Anpin and Abba and Ima are in the likeness of the cleaving of the Ein Sof in the parts of the thread. And Ze'ir Anpin is literally in the likeness of the thread — and is specifically called K"BH. And truly it is called by this Name in its being the one that encompasses and binds within it the Kodesh. And this is the meaning of K"BH putting on Tefillin — and its explanation is in the Zohar Vayetzei. And thus we know truly that the governance is in Ze'ir Anpin — for he is the governor according to what he encompasses of the rest. And he is Yaakov the chosen of the Patriarchs. And therefore even the action of the other higher Sefiros is attributed to him — for he is the one who acts according to what he uses from them. Ze'ir Anpin Is Blessed from Itself — Malchus Requires Blessing And there still remains to explain the matter of "Baruch Hu" — and it too is a great principle. And let me now say what I can of it. The Emanator did not make the real root for the lower beings — where their service would reach in particular — except Malchus. And since this is the first rule — we distinguish in particular the branches of the Tree — in everything that is from the dimension of Malchus. For all particulars need to be evaluated in the order of the ten Sefiros — then we will distinguish them and know them well. Therefore: everything that is from the dimension of Malchus: the Sefiros themselves are the vessel of Malchus in Atzilus; the vessels — in the building of the Sefiros; the reshimu — in the root in the Tzimtzum — and this place in particular shall be the vessel of the Malchus of Atzilus. And all that precedes — preparation and root for it. But in truth this level was set for service — to be diminished, G-d forbid, and to be filled according to the deeds of the lower beings. And what is above this — it is said: "I am Hashem — I have not changed." And therefore Malchus requires blessing — in the multiplication of blessings — when all its lights are complete in their power. But what is in the dimension of Ze'ir Anpin — it is blessed from itself always without change. And this is the matter of "Yisbarach" which is in the Kaddish — where it is forbidden to interrupt between le-alma and yisbarach — for "blessed to the worlds and worlds of worlds" is in the vessels that stand to be blessed. And "Yisbarach" — this is in the thread that blesses itself. And this one is in the thread — and that one is in Ze'ir Anpin. And it is impossible to elaborate further now. And in another letter I will complete this — please G-d — and also disclose to him a great secret — why in the Aramaic language they say Kudsha Brich Hu and not Kadisha. And I will answer the remaining questions. כד The Difference Between States of Katnus and Gadlus in the Supernal Adam and the Lower Adam Mantova, Thursday 29th Iyar 5491 Let me tell him a novelty that was renewed for me here — praise G-d. And it is the answer to a question that R. Aviad Sar Shalom asked me: for the Ari explained that there are mochin in the state of gestation (ibur) and also in nursing (yenika) and also in greatness (gadlus). And the mochin of gestation and nursing become the skull-membrane and bones for the mochin of gadlus. Yet regarding the human being below this does not appear to be so — and it should have been so — for from our flesh we perceive the Divine. And below — all is equal at all times. And I answered him: for this is the secret of the verse "a person is born for toil" (Adam le-amal yulad [Job 5:7]). And the matter: the gadlus of Ze'ir Anpin is only the preparation of the lights — that their entire power shall extend in them — until they arrive at a state fitting to produce offspring — for this is all that is desired of them. And this time is the time of gadlus — when the union happens — and not beforehand. For in gestation and nursing there is no union. And then they produce in their likeness and in their image — and from there the human being emerges with 613 complete organs in the exact likeness of gadlus itself. And the secret: "the creations of Bereishis were created in their full stature." And so it should have been always — for offspring should only come from gadlus — and the offspring should be like the producer. But Adam's sin caused this not to be — and that there be a time of gestation and nursing — and gadlus comes little by little. And the secret: for there is nothing new under the sun — and the form that was created — was created. Rather the rule is: even the offspring of a great light can descend below its root — and receive from a smaller light. And therefore — even though the human being came from gadlus — it was decreed for him that at first he receives only from katnus — and seasons will pass over him — and he will go receiving level after level — until he reaches his true level. And therefore his existence will not change — but the change will be in contraction and expansion — for in receiving from katnus — his existence contracts to appear in a small form. And afterward it expands little by little — according to what he receives from above. And the secret of all this: Tiferes and Yesod — for Tiferes is the large vav — and in this dimension the human being originally emerged. And afterward he returned to descend to the dimension of Yesod — the small vav. And then his form — as it was — was diminished and contracted. And what was a human being became a small child in Yesod. And this literally is the matter of the Tree of Life and the Tree of Knowledge — which are in Tiferes and Yesod. And the reason for the descent: for the Holy One wished to prepare him to be able to receive his punishment in the dominion of the brain and of sufferings over him — which could not have been when he was always rooted in Tiferes as at first. And the secret of this: "and now — lest he reach out his hand and take also from the Tree of Life" — and therefore He brought him down to the dimension of a child. And literally: "a person is born for toil" — for what was a human being became a child — for the need of toil. But the Torah in Tiferes can return him to his root even in his smallness. And this is "and the children of Reshef shall soar in flight" [Job 5:7] — and to save him from the toil that rules in Yesod. כה The Secret of the Decree Against Torah Books — and the Rectification Through Uninterrupted Torah Study Padova, Sunday 20th Sivan 5491 Regarding what he asked me about the decree against the books in the lands of the priests — my honored teacher already knows that I have withdrawn from speaking about these matters to others. But if so with others — I will not be so with my honored teacher as much as I can — especially since this is not a small matter but very great. And let me first tell the matter of these decrees against Torah — which came, to our great sorrow, from where they came — for nothing lacks a root. And the secret of this: "This is the statute of the Torah" [Numbers 19:2] — and its Aramaic translation is "this is the decree of Torah" — and it is known that this matter is alluded to here. And the secret of the matter is literally the matter of the Red Heifer — for the Shechina delivers Herself to the burning of harsh Din to save Israel — and She is the one given for the purification of the impure who have no purification except Her. These are those defiled with the most powerful impurity — the impurity of death. Therefore their only rectification is this one. And it itself is the impurity of exile — in the secret of "He placed me in dark places like the eternally dead." And therefore "she is the one that shall be upon the burning fire all the night" etc. But arousal for this must come from below — and therefore as long as the Temple stood — there was the ash of the Heifer. And since the Temple was destroyed and there is no Heifer — the Torah itself needed to be submitted thus to burning among the congregation of Israel — for this also rectifies the exile of the Torah. And just as when one Heifer was exhausted another had to be made — so one rectification endures until its time. But when the accusations intensify — G-d forbid — another rectification is needed. And the truth: the fence for this is that Israel should give their lives for Torah study. And therefore it says: "this is the Torah — a person who dies in a tent" — as the Sages expounded it. And therefore this verse was set to be expounded thus in this portion — and not in another portion. Uninterrupted Torah Study — the Solution for All Harsh Decrees And this I know I will tell — for certainly the accusation had already increased — until it could reach, G-d forbid, a great place. And we — praise G-d — acted in advance. And may G-d be willing — there shall be healing for all Israel for the wound. For these five months approximately — we already saw what was coming — and began a great rectification. As I shall now tell my honored teacher. And this advice is counseled for all the holy congregations of Italian Jewry — may their Rock protect them — to be saved from this trap their enemies set for them. And they should certainly attend to this. And it is not right for them to desist — for the matter is great and exceedingly powerful. This is the order we established in our house of study: for we already know what R. Shimon bar Yochai says in the book of the Zohar, Parashas Vayetzei, page 151a: "as long as this voice is not silent — the speech rules and prevails — and therefore the Torah must not cease." And there a little above: "all the time that the wise men rejoice in Torah — the Sama'el cannot prevail over them." And therefore we set ourselves to establish Torah study that shall have no interruption whatsoever. This is its law: we chose seven who volunteered for this — to obligate themselves to be collectively always studying from morning until evening — all days — they shall not be silent. And they made a condition among themselves — that this study shall be only for the rectification of all Israel. And therefore all shall be counted as one person — and none shall act for himself alone — but for all Israel. And in this order they will begin: immediately after the morning prayer — one shall sit in the place prepared for this — and there he shall learn his allotted time until the second comes — and takes the very book from him — and from where he finishes he begins — until the third comes and takes from him. And so they shall rotate and proceed until the emergence of the stars — each day accordingly. And each one in his time of study — his law is like one who prays the Eighteen Blessings — he may not interrupt in any kind of interruption in the world. And he shall not finish his study until the second begins — so that not even one moment shall the voice of Torah be interrupted. And the study is the book of the Zohar — the Tikkunim — and the Zohar Chadash. And we are found studying all of this every week. And we know that G-d has chosen this to nullify all harsh decrees — and in particular to be a wall against the harsh decree — G-d forbid. And now — let the wise men of Israel not cast this thing behind their backs. For I — were my strength adequate — I would establish this thing in every place. But let my honored teacher take this advice and let it be to my credit — for there is nothing like it for the good of all Israel. And every one in his place can do this — for it is not a difficult thing at all. And we are succeeding in this — praise G-d — and there are yet many excellent and wonderful aspects for us in this matter of study. כו General Service and Service for the Rectification of the Shechina — Rooted in Leah and Rachel Padova, Sunday Chol HaMoed Pesach 5492 Now let me come to the orders of the house of study. And truly I say — for after I thought and reconsidered and weighed three times to establish for myself a firm practice to conduct myself properly — this I saw and took to heart: for truly a person's way can only be proper when it is established and standing — to do what is pleasing to his Creator. Is this not so: to rectify the holy Shechina and to build Her — as transmitted to the children of Israel — His intimate nation — for which it was said: "it is time to act for Hashem"; "mighty ones doing His word"; "only in this shall the boaster boast"; "this has been mine"; "and the fool does not understand this" — as mentioned in the Ra'aya Mehemna and the Tikkunim. And I will also tell him one thing from what I explained yesterday on the verse: "these bones are all the house of Israel". For there are two types of love: the love of the Holy One Blessed is He — and the love of the Shechina. The love of the Holy One is found in all the pious of Israel who keep the charge of their G-d in truth — and tremble at every matter of mitzva — turning from evil and doing good. But the love of the Shechina is the desire and longing to rectify the Shechina with an actual rectification — according to her orders and the levels of her building. And this is the most chosen thing for Hashem of all deeds — for through this the praise of all the mighty ones of the world is expressed — and the difference between the earlier and later ones. And the root of all — is in the Sefiros. And the two services are rooted in the two Nukvas — Leah and Rachel. And the matter: for the bond of the King to the Shechina is always. But there is the inner dimension of the Nukva — in which there is no ascent and descent — but stands in equanimity to complete Ze'ir Anpin at all times. And this is the secret of "bone of my bone" — which does not change. But Rachel is the foundation of the house — she is the flesh — which is sometimes fat and sometimes becomes thin. And this is the matter of corruptions and rectifications found in her. And truly I should elaborate these words more — but I do not wish to depart from my subject. The rule of things: those who serve the general service — are rooted in Leah — the secret of the bone. And those who serve in the path of rectification of the Shechina — are rooted in the flesh which is Rachel. And at the end of exile — the matters have already reached: "she has none to guide her of all the sons she bore" [Lamentations 1:2]. And all Israel have been found as dry bones literally. · · · ✦ · · · End of the Letters — Colophon May Hashem remember for good the holy souls mentioned here — by whose merit the printing of this book was enabled. And these shall stand for blessing: the sons of the community of holy Italy — all of them guarded by the Master of all — to take this counsel and let it be to my credit — for there is nothing like it for the good of all Israel. And each one in his place can do this — for it is not a difficult thing at all. And we are succeeding in this — praise G-d. In the merit of Na Nach Nachma Nachman MayUman זיע״א. הסטירות הן הארות בדרך נודע ומושג לנו ,והן התחלה לנמצאים והנה אפרש בתחלה מהו ענין קדש .וכללא הוא :קדש — במוחין .אך צריך להבין הענין היטב ,כי !הוא] יסוד גדול לבניני החכמה .רחוק הוא המאציל ית״ש מערך ברואיו מרחק לא שיעור לו כלל .וביכלתו הכוללת כבר היה יכול להמציא כל הנמצאים בדרך לא נדע מה הוא ,וההפכיים בדרך א׳ יכול להמציאם ,כי אין שום חק וגבול ליכלתו .ואלמלא כך היה ,אז לא דברנו מבריאתו או מהנהגתו אפילו דבור אחד .וספירות לא נמצאו ,כי מציאותו הוא הממציא ותו לא מידי .וכאשר לא רצה כן .אלא לפעול בדרך הוא יודע אלינו, דרך קרוב למציאותנו — אז המציאת הספירות ,הן המה הארותיו בדרך נודע ומו שג ,אשר כמו שהוא בפשיטות מציאותו ית״ש איננו כמו קודם מחייב הנמשך .כי אין ערך למציאותו עם הנמצא ממנו כלל ,וע״כ לא נקראהו התחלה .כן הארותיו אלה הם באמת התחלה לנמצאים ,כי מן החסד יתחייבו המים .ו מן הגבורה האש ,והחסד לא יוליד אש ,ולא גבורה מים .והרי נמצאו התחלות שונות להפכיים .מה שכל אחד היה יכול לעשותם.

ז־׳א בקבלו המוחין נקרא קדוש נחזור לענין :כי כל המציאות קדש .וכפי התרחקו מן הקורבה אשר לועם התחתונים נעלה מדריגת קדושתו .וזה מה שקראו לע״ק באד׳׳ר קדש קדשים דקודשיא ,כי הקודשיא הם זו׳׳ן ,וקדשי הקודשיא — או״א ,ו קדש קדשים דקודשיא — א״א ,כי כן מתעלות המדריגות זו מזו .ונמצא באמת היות זו׳׳ן הם הקרובים אלינו יותר — הנאמר בהם ״והנגלות לנו ולבנינו״ ,וזה להיותם נחשבים לז״ת ,כי הם המולידים עניני העולם בהמשך כנ״ל .והמוחין — או״א באצילות או חב״ד בז״א ,הם הרחוקים מן הקורבה הזאת ,ע״כ נקראם קדש ,וז״א בקבלו המוחין יקרא קדוש ,דהיינו שהקדש בו.

הקו והרשימו המ בערך ז׳׳א ומלכות והנה כבר הבננו ענין קדש וקדוש ,אך דבר זה מתעלה מאד מאד למעלה למעלה ,והוא סוד גדולונ שגב מאד אשר לא היה ניתן להגלות כ״כ .כי אם למען הדרת כ״ת אשר כ בודו חובה עלי אפרש עתה מה שאוכל בזה הענין. ואדוני החכם כמלאך האלקים יבין דבר מתוך דבר .כי לא אוכל ארחיב הרבה. חוט הא״ס ית״ ש הוא הפועל כל הפעולות הנכללות בעשר הספירות .אשר בעשות המאציל ית״ש הגבול ל אורו — הניח הרשימו ,והוא הנשאר מן הגבול הזה; כילא סילק הגבול אתכל הארתו ,כי אם מיעטה .והנשאר במיעוט הזה הוא■ הרשימו .והוא בחינת מלכות .פי רוש :שכאשר תמצאנה הספירות ,ונעריך כל הדברים תמיד בערך ע״ס האלה ,נמצא הרשימו לערך מלכות .והחוט הבא בתוך הרשימו הן הוא הארה יותר גדולהואור יותר חזק, אשר לא הניחו הגבול הראשון ,ונתרבה עליו אח״כ ברצון המאציל ית״ש. ונמצאו החוט והרשימו בערך ו״ה של השם ב״ה ,דהיינו ז״ת ,והא״ס ית״ש נשגב מזה ,דהיינו רחוק לג מרי מהולדת שום נמצא תחתון בהמשך ,אפילו כסבת סבה .ועכ״ז לא נתרחק לגמרי ,כי הוא פונה אל ההולדה הזאת ,ובלתי פניתו והתדבקותו לא היה מציאות לשום הארה .כי הארתו הםכל המאורות. וכלל זה צריך להיות ביד כל מבין בחכמה .כי תלויה כל הידיעה בהבחנת מדריגות הארת המאציל ית״ש ,והמשכם זו מזו. ואם הייתי יכול להאריך .הייתי מבאר לו מאמרים הרבה עמוקים בס׳ הזוהר המובנים בהקדמות האלה .אך אפס מקום ואפס זמן .וכ״ת ידע לישב
אותם על מאמריהם בבואם לפניו ,והרבה יבין בתפלח אליהו ז״ל בראש ם׳ התיקונים.

כינוי הקדוש ב־ה מורה על התדבקות א־־ם בחוט כדוגמת .מוחין בז׳־א. נחזור לענין .כי התדבקות הא׳׳ס ית״ש בחוט הזה — הנה סודו כסוד המוחין בז״א .ונמצא החוט שהוא כללות כל הספירות בסוד ז״א ,והוא קדוש, כיקדשו התרבקות הא״ס .ואנו מדברים בקרוב יותר אלינו ,ולא ברחוק ממנו לגמרי ,ולזה החוט נקרא קב״ה באמת .ובבואנו לפרט ,הנה אע״פ שכל הספירות והפרצופים הם חלקי החוט לבד .סוף סוף א״א או״א בדמות התדבקות הא״ם ית״ש הם בחלקי החוט .והז״א הוא ממש בדמות החוט, ונקרא בפרט קב״ה .אך באמת נקרא בשם זה בהעלותךותו כולל וקושר בו הקדש, והוא מ״ ש קב״ה מניח תפלין ,ופי׳ זה בזוהר פ׳ ויצא .וכן נדע באמת היות ההנהגה בז״א .כי הוא המנהיג לפי מה שכולל בומן השאר ,והוא יעקב בחיר שבאבות .וע״כ אפילו פעולת שאר הספירות העליונות ניחסה אליו .כי הוא הפועל לפי מה שמשתמש מהם .ואני יורע כיכל הדברים האלה היו צריכים ביאור רחב .אך הכל בבת אחת אינני יכול .ע״כ יקח כ״ת עתה אתזה .ובאיזה חלק שי חפוץ ביאור יותר יצוני ואעבדהו .כללות הענין :כינוי הקב״ה נאה בראשונה אל חוט א״ס ית״ש ,ובפרטיות חלקי החוט אל ז״א .ויר מוז לפעמים לספירות אחרות ,אך באמת יהיה הרמז בז״א בהנהיגו לפי הספירות ההם.

ז׳־א מבורך מעצמו ,והמלכות צריכה לברכה. ונשאר עדיין לפרש ענין ב״ה ,והוא ג״כ עיקר גדול .ואומר עתה מה שאוכל ממנו :לא עשה המאציל ית״ש ל שור ש ממש לתחתונדם .שתגיע שם עבודתם ביחוד ,אלא המלכות .ובהעלותךות זה הכלל הראשון ,הנה נבחין בפרטיות ענפי האילן כלמה שהוא מבחינת מלכות .פי׳ כי כבר אמרתי ,איך כל הפרטים צריך לערוך אותם כסדר ע״ס ,אז נבחינם ונדעם היטב .וע״כ אמרתי כלמה שהוא מבחינת מלכות ,ונבין בזה מלכות — באצילות ,הכלים — בבנין הספירות ,הרשימו — בשרש בצמצום; ויהיה מקום זה ביחוד כלי המלכות דאצילות .וכל הקודמים
